hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/claude_pretool_guard.py"; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ "$rc" -ne 2 ]; then echo "AARYX guard crashed (exit $rc); command blocked." >&2; fi; exit 2; fi; done; echo 'AARYX guard: Python 3.11+ not found (tried python3, python, py); command blocked.' >&2; exit 2
